snapshot_rule: enumerate the exact Git tree with git ls-tree -r --full-tree at query_cutoff_commit and read each eligible blob with <commit>:<path>; never read the working tree for a historical snapshot

registered_factor_only.reason: measure the value and leakage risk of a curated summary separately

unitization.stable_unit_id: sha256 over versioned canonical identity containing source_type, path, locator, and search_text_sha256; exclude snapshot_commit so unchanged content keeps one ID across snapshots
unitization.markdown: CommonMark 0.31.2 ATX and Setext heading section with heading-path text plus direct body; normalize source CRLF/CR to LF, strip only outer blank lines, preserve internal Unicode and whitespace without NFC rewriting; child bodies are separate; fenced-code heading lookalikes are not headings; preserve heading path, occurrence, and exact historical line span in the hidden locator
unitization.markdown_preamble: non-empty content before the first heading is one explicit preamble unit
unitization.project_memory: one event per unit from the historical events.jsonl blob; search text serializes title, summary, non-empty body, and tags in that fixed order with LF labels; event ID, operation, kind, confidence, status, times, provenance refs, supersession, and relations stay backend-hidden; superseded events remain available for temporal gold and derived active status stays backend-hidden
unitization.catalog_csv: RFC 4180 parse with the historical header; search text serializes header-value pairs in frozen source-column order; malformed or duplicate headers fail closed
unitization.catalog_jsonl: one I-JSON object per line with unique member names; canonical search text follows RFC 8785 JCS and UTF-8; non-I-JSON numbers or duplicate names fail closed
unitization.oversize: under one frozen UTF-8 byte ceiling including repeated heading context: split at parsed CommonMark block boundaries; if one block still exceeds the remaining budget split at the latest Unicode whitespace boundary; if none exists split at a valid UTF-8 code-point boundary; use zero overlap and record method part index/count in hidden metadata and locator
unitization.exact_duplicates: collapse identical search_text hashes into one ranked unit and preserve every source alias
unitization.near_duplicates: preserve and report; do not tune a similarity deduplicator on test

historical_tree_controls.git_object_format: record sha1 or sha256 from the repository; never infer the algorithm only from an unlabeled digest
historical_tree_controls.portable_blob_integrity: record SHA-256 of exact blob bytes in addition to the Git typed object name
historical_tree_controls.unsupported_action: exclude with a counted reason before unitization; never follow a link into the working tree

query_privacy.public_query: may use an explicit public Git locator receipt
query_privacy.private_query: store verbatim text and origin mapping only in local-restricted storage; publish opaque IDs and aggregate receipts
allowed_private_receipts: keyed digest with key outside Git
query_privacy.attestation_limit: a pre-output statement records process provenance but is not independent proof; capture order must be audited separately

deterministic_validator_requirements.canonical_unit_id: recompute the versioned identity hash and reject any unit_id mismatch; JSON Schema alone cannot enforce a cryptographic derivation
deterministic_validator_requirements.backend_projection: serialize exactly unit_id and search_text and byte-audit that no hidden field reaches B1/B2/C1/C2
deterministic_validator_requirements.aliases: reject duplicate path-locator aliases and require deterministic canonical-source selection
deterministic_validator_requirements.query_receipts: generate private random receipts with a CSPRNG or keyed digests with HMAC-SHA-256; schema patterns are shape checks, not entropy proofs
deterministic_validator_requirements.source_exclusions: reject every path matching query, label, gold, blind, API, artifact, raw, test, script, tool, cache, secret, symlink, gitlink, binary, or non-UTF-8 rules before unitization
deterministic_validator_requirements.control_characters: search_text may contain tab and LF but no other C0 control or DEL byte
deterministic_validator_requirements.oversize_split: reconstruct all parts in part-index order and require byte-identical logical content after removing repeated heading context; reject missing duplicate or out-of-range parts and every chunk over the frozen ceiling

pending_before_execution: freeze UTF-8 byte ceiling on outcome-hidden development
